what_happened: Citation sweep (grep for 'gate N' by number across *.md/*.sh/*.json) cleanly resolved the placement question the dispatch posed: gate 20 alone has 131 by-number citations, so inserting the new lint beside gate 17 (renumbering 18-22) would have silently broken all of them. Appending as a trailing gate 23 avoids any renumbering. Also found that the git-staging-scope.md bullet this task owns has a premise ('natural wiring point: gate 17, alongside its sibling') that this research supersedes -- implement must rewrite the sentence, not just flip its status word.

Research report's mechanical change inventory missed that test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh case (c) hard-codes 23 in invalid_cases=("abc" "0" "23" "1,abc" "1,99") as an out-of-range gate id. Adding gate 23 inverts that assertion and would have failed the suite at implement time. Caught at plan time by reading the test in full rather than trusting the report's line enumeration. Also: the report's verify-deploy.sh line numbers were stale because commit 7da3e047a landed after the research pass (file grew 1204 -> 1238 lines), so every plan step anchors on text rather than line number.

Gate 4's source-store SKIP-guard removal in 7da3e047a was correctly ruled NON-transferable to the new gate: lint-directory-pathspec-boundary.sh defaults its scan root to PROJECT_ROOT/agent-system/extensions and exits 2 with 'default scan root not found' when absent, so it genuinely cannot run in a deploy consumer, unlike check-task-references.sh. Verified by reading the lint's root-resolution block, not inferred.

Full (non-skip-slow) verify-deploy.sh baseline run hit the inner 540s timeout inside gate 8's shell suite runner (exit=124); re-ran once with --skip-slow per the plan's own contingency step to get a usable baseline (FAIL -- 1 of 35 check(s) failed).

Pre-change baseline's sole FAIL (gate 5, manifest-driven verification) cites 2 findings, both lean extension stale-deploy diffs (context/project/lean4/README.md, context/project/lean4/domain/ladder-counter-observables.md), matching the dispatch's own deploy-freshness-context note. A transient third finding on scripts/lib/record-version-patterns.sh appeared in the earlier non-skip-slow attempt and was gone by the skip-slow re-run, consistent with task 281's concurrent in-flight edit on that file settling between the two runs. Both attributed as pre-existing/sibling noise, not this task's regression.

Phase 4's doc-gate subset (--only-gate 3,4) FAILs at gate 3 (doc-lint), not because of this task's git-staging-scope.md bullet edit (which is correctly reconciled, index-entries.json line_count 748), but for two attributable reasons outside this task's scope: (1) deployed-vs-source script content drift for verify-deploy.sh and test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh, the expected consequence of this task's own Phase 2/3 edits pending the orchestrator's next redeploy; and (2) ten unrelated index-entries.json line_count mismatches on context docs owned by concurrent sibling tasks (plan-format.md, return-metadata-file.md, context-discovery.md, external-process-wait.md, bounded-build-waiter.md, state-management-schema.md, conclusion-stage.md, task-reference-exemptions.md, orchestrate-batch-results-template.md, task-abandon-mode.md), confirmed absent at Phase 1's baseline. A first generate-context-line-counts.sh --write run touched all 11 mismatched entries (mine plus the 10 foreign ones) since the script operates repo-wide; the 10 foreign ones were manually reverted via sed before committing to stay inside this task's territory.
git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.
